en.hook: Resolve AsyncPG connection pool starvation during live event bursts.
en.body:
Resolve AsyncPG connection pool starvation during live event bursts. Eliminate 503 spikes and p99 latency regressions using acquire timeouts and pooling.

Operational proof is in the GitHub repository referenced in this post.
en.cta: Read the full article on the site, then open GitHub for operational proof.
